BEFORE  HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SOUMITRA SAIKIA  ORDER Date : 14.06.2024 Heard Mr. R. Deka, learned counsel for the petitioner.

Also heard Ms. R.S.
Chowdhury, learned Standing Counsel, ASLSA representing respondent No.4.
This writ petition is filed by the writ petitioner praying for victim compensation of Rs.5,00,000/-
(Rupees five lakhs) only as it is submitted that the petitioner was physically violated by the person named as an accused in the FIR on 13.06.2019.
The FIR was received and registered on 19.06.2019 and was registered as Kokrajhar Police Station Case No. 288/2019 under Section 376 of IPC.
The matter was pending before the Trial Court as Sessions Case No. 134/2019.
However, this case abated as the accused died during the pendency of the trial on 03.03.2021.
The petitioner was granted interim compensation of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees fifty thousand) only by the District Legal Services Authority, Kokrajhar.
However, Page No.# 3/3 the compensation as required under the provisions of the victim compensation scheme framed under the Government of Assam has not been received.
Being aggrieved, she has ventilated her grievances before the Assam State Legal Services Authority as well as the District Legal Services Authority.
However, the same was not redressed and therefore, she has approached before this Court.

During the pendency of the writ petition, the petitioner was granted a compensation of Rs.3,00,000/- (Rupees three lakhs) only by the District Legal Services Authority, Kokrajhar by Sunduri Basumatary vs The State Of Assam And 4 Ors on 14 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/195896523/
2 order dated 24.07.2023.
Let the learned Government Advocate produce the relevant records before the Court containing the order dated 24.07.2023 passed by the District Legal Services Authority, Kokrajhar, whereby an amount of Rs.3,00,000/- (Rupees three lakhs) only has been paid as final compensation to the writ petitioner.

sentences.text: This record is directed to be called for in view of the submissions made by the learned counsel for the petitioner that the victim/writ petitioner was not aware of this order which was passed on 24.07.2023.
The learned Government Advocate will apprise the Court if copy thereof was served on the victim/the writ petitioner and the manner in which it was done.
Let the matter be listed again on 27th June, 2024.
A copy of this order be marked to the Office of Ms. S. Baruah, learned Government Advocate for onward communication.
